name: Monster Gals - Dating Simulator
source:
You just wanted to rent some dvd’s and ended up stranded in another world full of MONSTERS! Try to find your way back home while meeting some very curious, possibly undiagnosed neurodivergent but very cute monster girls who might help you (if they feel like it).

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743860/Monster_Gals__Voyage/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你只是想租一些DVD，结果却被困在另一个充满怪物的世界！尝试找到回家的路，同时遇到一些非常好奇、可能尚未确诊的神经分歧但非常可爱的怪物女孩，她们可能会帮助你（如果她们愿意的话）。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743860/Monster_Gals__Voyage/]Steam[/url]]
